items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 22 at 11:32PM CST until November 23 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...From 9 PM this evening to noon CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Caution flags and additional Small Craft
Advisories will be needed through mid week.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
